card.name: The word age in age groups
card.fires_on: The word "age" right after this, these, other, or all, in the phrase "age group(s)". Also fires on "aged" before a number of years.

modes.label: Age group phrase
modes.description: "age" follows a pointing word such as this, these, other or all, and comes before "group".
modes.example: greater variability of response in this<< age>> group.

modes.label: Aged with years
modes.description: "aged" is used before an age such as 65 and over in a study population.
modes.example: sufficient numbers of subjects<< aged>> 65 and over
